The length of the words is the only clue that will help you find all the words and solve the puzzles. Therefore, Zen Word has very high requirements for your vocabulary and spelling skills. All word puzzles in Zen Word are carefully designed and will definitely give you a completely different challenging experience. 

Also, Zen Word is very different from word-search games. In word search games, your objective is to find and mark all the words hidden inside the letters box. As you find more words, the difficulty of word search games gets easier. However in Zen Word, as you find more words, the difficulty of the game will increase sharply. 6778822286.name: Control the Meeting
6778822286.desc:
Meeting Card Battle is a short strategy card game where you take the role of a meeting facilitator and try to guide a difficult meeting toward a final decision.

Each meeting includes participants with different personalities.
Some talk too much, some go off topic, some object to everything, some stay silent, some demand evidence, and some want decisions as quickly as possible.

Each turn, you choose one card from your hand.
Cards include actions such as summarizing the discussion, asking a question, using a whiteboard, hearing concerns, taking a vote, or making a decision.

However, card effects are not always predictable.
Participants react based on their personalities. A card may move the meeting forward, but it may also increase confusion, reduce satisfaction, or cost valuable time.

Your goal is to reach a decision before the meeting falls apart.
You win if the decision goal is reached while satisfaction and confusion stay under control.
You lose if satisfaction reaches zero, confusion becomes too high, or time runs out.

Cards are divided into three groups: Organize, Dialogue, and Force.
Repeating the same type of card too often can worsen the meeting atmosphere.
To win, you need to read the room, choose the right card, and balance progress with satisfaction.

Difficulty levels change the number of participants and how many people react each turn.
Lower difficulties are easier to manage, while higher difficulties create more unpredictable and chaotic meetings.

6754558455.name: Marble Sort!

Satisfying ASMR physics meets endless strategy. Time your drops, ride the moving conveyor, and perfectly sort the marbles with logic and strategy  before the belt clogs.

*Marble Sort* takes the classic sorting puzzle genre and adds a highly dynamic twist. Tap the top boxes to release marbles, watch them bounce with realistic physics, and ride the circular conveyor to their matching trays. But beware: the belt never stops moving!

- Satisfying ASMR Physics: Feel the tactile joy of marbles dropping, clinking, and locking perfectly into place.

Strategize your drops, clear the board, and become the ultimate sorting master. Let the fun roll!

Download Marble Sort today and let the fun roll!

6754243057.name: Arrow Out
6754243057.desc:
Arrow Out is a clever directional puzzle where every move matters, designed for fans of brain and mind challenges. Your goal is simple: guide the right arrow through the maze and reach freedom in this smart escape experience.

Rotate arrows, shift tiles, and plan ahead using pure logic and spatial thinking. Smooth flow and responsive tap controls make every decision feel precise and satisfying.

With gradually increasing difficulty and thousands of handcrafted levels, Arrow Out stands among the best games for iq improvement, training, and problem solving. Each level works like a compact teaser, pushing you to think ahead and adapt.

When a level gets tricky, helpful boosters are there to support you:
Use Zoom to closely inspect complex paths, Hint to reveal a helpful move, Magic Wand to break through difficult situations, Rubber to erase mistakes, and Grid Scale to adjust the board for better visibility and planning.

Game Features
• Direction-based logic puzzles with evolving mechanics
• Relaxing yet challenging brain training games experience
• Thoughtful escape puzzle and shape escape level design
• Offline-friendly play with no wifi games for free
• Precision controls, helpful boosters, and a comfortable dark mode for extended play

Arrow Out blends brain games, mind games, and smart interaction into a polished experience that rewards patience and clever thinking.

Can you find the way out — or will your arrows go in circles?

6450834358.name: Sunday City: Life Simulator
6450834358.desc:
May your dreams become reality in Sunday City.

Sunday City is an eternal summer simulator, where each day is like a weekend, and the city hums to the rhythm of your desires. You don't need to wait for a vacation here — ocean, sun, and neon city lights are always right there with you. Choose your lifestyle: calm and relaxed or full of drive and adventure. Experience that unparalleled vibe and become a success!

Reach the Top
Go on an unbelievable journey from a simple courier to a multimillionaire. Complete quests: work and get paid, partake in sports car racing, chat with your friends, and open businesses. Express yourself in any way possible, and then, all the roads to Sunday City will be open for you.

Start a Business
Open your first café, electronics or comic book shop. That way, you'll be earning profits and thus gradually getting closer and closer to the status of a successful entrepreneur, simultaneously starting new businesses and building your capital. But not everything is so serious here, so relax, you've still got beach parties to go to!

Time for Fun
In Sunday City, you can hang out in the chat, socialize, and find new friends. As well as enjoy endless parties, shop around, and switch skins to your mood. Riding on a scooter or driving a sports car, luxury brands and private parties or athletic style and yoga classes, beach volleyball, cozy nights with friends — it's all up to you. All this will become your reality, just take a step towards your dream!

Loyal Fri

POV: it’s your first summer in the city of eternal summer. Here’s what’s new:

6761469046.name: Rap Star:Idle Clicker
6761469046.desc:
From streets to stardom — tap, rap, earn, date, collect. Rap Star: Idle Clicker is a rap life simulator meets idle tycoon. Start with $1 and build your rap empire. Every tap rewrites your destiny.
TAP TO RAP, STACK CASH Every tap is money. From freestyling on corners to sold-out stadiums, your rap career starts from zero. Invest in studios, unlock new flows, hire producers. Even offline, your hustle never stops.
FROM BROKE TO BILLIONAIRE A busted car with no AC and one dollar. That's all you start with. But the finish line is a penthouse, a private jet, and an island with your name on it. Upgrade your crib, car, clothes, studio — watch your world transform from ruins to empire. Not a fairy tale. A real, brick-by-brick come-up.
BUILD YOUR MUSIC EMPIRE More than making songs — build an empire. Own a record label, launch fashion lines, sign rising stars. Drop singles that break the internet, top the charts, become a cultural icon. Every choice shapes your legend.
MINI-GAMES THAT KEEP YOU HOOKED Your rap career isn't just tapping — addictive mini-games pop up throughout your rise. The faster your fingers, the faster your fame.
ROMANCE — STARS ARE NEVER ALONE When you reach the top, the women follow. They're not accessories — each one has her own story, her own temper, her own world. Take her somewhere romantic and watch her melt. Take her somewhere ridiculous and watch her flip. Give her a cheap little gift to make her smile, or drop serious cash on luxury and watch her scream. 6781268810.name: Fandogh - Words Master
6781268810.desc:
Simply swipe your finger over the letters to connect them, build words, and unlock your inner wordsmith! Becoming a true master takes focus, so get ready to uncover the hidden secrets of words and give your brain the ultimate power-up.

6766553696.name: Minitris
6766553696.desc:
Rediscover the timeless puzzle classic that took the world by storm!

Minitris is a minimalist falling-block puzzle with a vibrant twist. Designed for players of all ages—from toddlers to puzzle masters—Minitris strips away the complexity of traditional block games to focus on pure, addictive strategy.

Every block is a simple square, but the challenge lies in the color. Your mission? Match three or more blocks of the same color—horizontally, vertically, or diagonally—to clear the board and keep the game alive.

Why you’ll love Minitris:

Play in Seconds: With ultra-simple tap or swipe controls, you’ll be playing (and winning!) in no time.

Stress-Free Strategy: No complex shapes to rotate. Just pure color-matching fun.

Chasing the High Score: Earn big points with combo clears and multi-set matches. The faster you play, the more you earn!

A Piece of Gaming History: Originally born on DOS in 1989, Minitris has been refined over decades to provide the perfect casual experience.

The Legacy Continues
First released in 1989 and later a Windows favorite, Minitris reached 50 countries in its first 50 days. Decades later, the goal remains the same: a game simple enough for a child, yet deep enough for an adult.

6780308500.name: Xếp Gạch
6780308500.desc:
Xếp Gạch là trò chơi xếp gạch nhịp nhanh được thiết kế dành cho điện thoại cảm ứng. Thay vì các nút điều khiển phức tạp, bạn chỉ cần chạm và vuốt để điều khiển các khối gạch, giúp việc chơi trở nên tự nhiên và mượt mà hơn.

Mục tiêu rất đơn giản: sắp xếp các khối gạch để hoàn thành hàng ngang, xóa hàng và ghi điểm cao nhất có thể trước khi bàn chơi bị lấp đầy.

Tính năng nổi bật:

• Điều khiển bằng chạm và vuốt trực quan
• Nhịp độ tăng dần theo thời gian
• Hệ thống tính điểm hấp dẫn
• Chơi ngoại tuyến, không cần Internet
• Thiết kế hiện đại với hiệu ứng neon nổi bật
• Phù hợp cho mọi lứa tuổi
• Khởi động nhanh, chơi nhanh mọi lúc

Cách chơi:

• Chạm để xoay khối gạch
• Vuốt trái hoặc phải để di chuyển
• Vuốt xuống để tăng tốc độ rơi
• Hoàn thành hàng ngang để ghi điểm
• Tránh để các khối gạch chạm đỉnh bàn chơi

Bạn có thể đạt được bao nhiêu điểm?

Hãy tải Xếp Gạch ngay hôm nay và thử thách tốc độ phản xạ, khả năng quan sát và tư duy sắp xếp của mình.

6780354110.name: JACL Interactive Fiction
6780354110.desc:
JACL brings the golden age of text adventures to your iPad. There are no buttons to mash and no twitch reflexes required — you read where you are, type what you want to do ("open the door", "take the lantern", "go north"), and the story responds. It's interactive fiction the way it was meant to be: you and
your imagination, one sentence at a time.

The app comes with a shelf of ready-to-play adventures spanning several languages and moods — from a fantasy dungeon to a quiet stroll through Paris — so there's something to play the moment you open it.

FEATURES

• A built-in bookshelf of adventures, ready to play offline
• Never lose your place — every game auto-saves, so returning to the shelf and
  coming back drops you exactly where you left off
• Named save points for marking the moments you want to return to
• A tap-to-open map that charts the rooms you've explored
• Sound and music in games that support it
• Tap and hold any word to look it up in the dictionary
• Comfortable, adjustable serif reading — set your text size once and it sticks
• Light, Dark, or System appearance for the reading screen
• Designed for iPad, in portrait or landscape

WHO IT'S FOR

If you grew up with text adventures in the 1980s, this is your nostalgia machine. If you've never played one, it's the gentlest possible introduction to a whole genre of story-driven games. The bundled adventures range from family-friendly puzzles to mature, tongue-in-cheek action, so there's room to
grow into.

More ad

6780354544.name: Haunted School Escape
6780354544.desc:
Trapped in a haunted school after sunset. Inspect every object in the classroom, find the key, decode the safe, and escape before the ghosts catch you.

Each room hides one critical clue. Touch the wrong object and you trigger a jumpscare — lose a life and watch the ghost slip into your codex.

FEATURES
- Five themed haunted rooms (classroom, science lab, art room, music room, bathroom)
- Hand-drawn ghost catalog: discover and collect every scare
- 4-digit safe puzzles with clues scattered around the room
- Tense ambient horror — no gore, just dread
- One-tap inspection, easy to learn
- Watch a rewarded ad to revive when you lose all lives

Can you survive the night and escape Haunted School?

Developer: ALIENZ
Contact: support@alienz.ooo

6780849373.name: Arrower: Arrow Logic Puzzle
6780849373.desc:
Every arrow wants out. Only one path is clear.
 
Arrower is a calm, brain-bending logic puzzle. Each arrow is a snake on the grid, pointing at the edge it wants to slide out through. But it can only leave if nothing is blocking its path. Clear the right arrow first and the board opens up. Clear the wrong one and you're stuck. Read the gridlock, find the order, set every arrow free.

Simple to learn, deeply satisfying to solve.

FEATURES
 - 2,500 hand-tuned levels across a campaign that grows with you
 - A fresh Daily Challenge every day, with streaks to keep
 - Three-star scoring  - beat par moves and finish with hearts to spare
 - A holding tray and other twists that bend the rules as you climb
 - Four hand-picked themes: Classic Parchment, Forest Calm, Midnight Ink, Golden Sand
 - Pinch to zoom and pan on larger boards
 - Satisfying sound and haptic feedback (toggle anytime)
 - Plays fully offline - no account, no sign-up

NO PRESSURE
No timers. No lives that lock you out. No nagging. Solve at your own pace, whenever you want a quiet mental reset.
Free to play, with an optional one-time purchase to remove ads.

Think you can clear all 2,500? 
Start untangling.
6780849373.releaseNotes:
Three new soundtracks. Midnight, Nature, and Parchment — pick the mood that gets you in the zone from the Theme picker.
Game Center support. Earn achievements as you progress through the campaign and climb the daily challenge leaderboard.
Cloud save. Your progress syncs across devices so you never lose a streak.
Smoother start. Level 1 has been redesigned as a gentler intro to the exit-corridor mechanic.
Bug fixes and polish. Including a fix for the in-app rating prompt getting stuck on level 10 — sorry about that one.

6780201611.name: 三根毛
6780201611.desc:
《三根毛》是一款荒謬可愛的 3D 探索解謎遊戲。你要帶著只有三根毛、圓滾滾又勇敢的小角色，在巨貓法庭的夜晚現場蒐證、撞牆、聞小襪子，最後完成一場非常不正經但很認真的判決。
遊戲主線圍繞「巨貓法庭夜審」展開。你需要從牆壁吐槽中找提示，撞開可疑紙箱，取得小襪子的氣味線索，把證物排成正確順序，再用 A 級斜角衝刺震度打開審判門。
除了主線，場景裡還藏著多個小事件與圖鑑目標。你可以完成失蹤小魚乾案、紙箱城堡案、襪子氣味鑑定、牆內小劇場、浴盆泡泡暗道、櫃子三色密碼等支線，讓紀錄本留下更多稱號與通關紀錄。
特色：
可愛荒謬的 3D 貓咪法庭世界
第三人稱探索、互動、彈跳衝刺與撞擊回饋
主線解謎：牆證詞、紙箱證物、襪子氣味、證物排序、法庭問答
圖鑑與紀錄本：保存通關次數、最高震度、累積證物與稱號
中途存檔：關閉 App 後可從首頁繼續夜審
支線小事件：每次重玩都能補完不同小案件
拍照模式與首頁紀錄，適合留下三根毛的辦案瞬間
這不是一款嚴肅的法庭遊戲。這是一場由紙箱、小襪子、小魚乾和圓滾滾小偵探共同推動的夜審。

6779980381.name: 42E
6779980381.desc:
El juego de futbol para jugar entre amigos, con un solo celular pasado por turnos.

EL IMPOSTOR
Todos ven el mismo futbolista en la pantalla. Menos uno, el impostor. Cada jugador da una pista sobre quien es, pero el impostor no sabe quien es y tiene que inventar algo creible para no quedar expuesto. Al final, el grupo vota quien creen que es el impostor. 

VELOCIMETRO
Dos equipos. Un jugador gira el velocimetro y la aguja cae en algun punto de una escala tematica, por ejemplo, mejores regateadores. Donde el maximo es Messi y el minimo es ese amigo que se cree Neymar. Ese jugador le da una pista a su companero sin mostrarle la pantalla para que coloque la aguja lo mas cerca posible. Cuanto mas preciso, mas puntos. Tematicas nuevas en cada ronda.

6779613071.name: ShadowCourier
6779613071.desc:
Move through moonlit districts as a shadow courier on missions no one else can complete. Study patrol patterns, slip past guard vision cones, hide in barrels, and deliver sealed messages before you are spotted.

Shadow Courier combines top-down stealth with route planning. Each district offers checkpoints, shortcuts, and hide spots with different risk levels. Choose a fast, safe, or balanced route at briefing, then execute under pressure as guards chase, search, and spread the alarm.

Progress through five districts, from the Harbor to the Citadel. Earn seals for clean delivery, staying unseen, and beating par time. Collect coins, unlock cosmetics, and pick up your route anytime from the city map.

Night routes. Silent steps. Deliver the message unseen.

6780208273.name: Pixu Pipes - Pipe Flow
6780208273.desc:
Rotate the pipe tiles to flow water from the faucet to the cups. Learn the rule in a second, solve in the fewest turns.

Pixu Pipes is a calm, ad-free connect puzzle with a zero-server data model. There is no losing — think as long as you like.

• Four difficulty packs: Beginner, Easy, Medium, Hard — hundreds of levels
• Daily puzzle: the same board for everyone, every day
• Game Center leaderboard: solve in the fewest turns
• Light & dark theme, sound & haptics
• iPhone, iPad and Mac (Catalyst)
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no third-party SDKs

Every board is guaranteed solvable. Rotate the pipes, get the water to the cup, collect stars.

6778954782.name: Orbinaut
6778954782.desc:
One orb. Two rings. One tap.

Orbinaut is a pick-up-and-play arcade game about staying alive. Your orb races endlessly around glowing neon rings — tap anywhere to hop between lanes, dodge the spikes, and grab gems for bonus points. Every run starts gentle and gets faster, until one wrong hop ends it all.

Simple to learn, hard to master. Rounds last under two minutes, restarts are instant, and your high score is always on screen daring you to beat it.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap anywhere to hop between the inner and outer ring
• Dodge the spikes — one touch ends your run
• Collect gems, grab the rare bonus star, and ride the shield
• Survive as the speed climbs and the rings shift colour

FEATURES
• One-touch controls anyone can pick up — great for all ages
• Daily Challenge: one shared board for the whole world, every day
• Level up every 20 points as the rings change colour and the pace rises
• REVERSE rounds that flip your direction (always with a warning!)
• A shield power-up that lets you bulldoze through spikes
• Crashed? Use an extra life and keep your best run alive
• Game Center leaderboards — take on the world's best Orbinauts
• 8 achievements to unlock
• High score and stats sync across your devices with iCloud
• Slick neon visuals, satisfying haptics and arcade sound
• Game controller support and iOS Game Mode
• No ads. No tracking. No waiting, no energy systems.

Can you beat 1000?

6474043167.name: MLB® The Show™ Mobile Baseball
6474043167.desc:
Step up to the plate and start building your dream roster!
MLB® The Show™ Mobile lets you collect player cards featuring today’s superstars and legendary Hall of Famers. Build your ultimate squad, upgrade your lineup, and battle other players using officially licensed MLB and MLBPI teams and athletes! Play Ball!

Collect over 900 player cards and create your ultimate lineup with modern icons and all-time greats like Mickey Mantle, Hank Aaron, and Ken Griffey Jr. Upgrade your roster, refine your strategy, and prove you have what it takes to own the diamond!

- Incredible graphics powered by over 16,000 unique animations!

Enter a vibrant world of glowing jewels where creativity and puzzle-solving come together in perfect harmony! Designed for easy, relaxing fun, this one-of-a-kind experience combines color sorting, pixel art creation, and satisfying casual gameplay all in one. To survive this cataclysm, you must master both strategic command and survival instinct! 

X-Clash offers the following advice to all survivors: True power lies not in brute strength, but in forging unbreakable bonds with your companions. Assemble your fellowship wisely - their lineage holds the key to victory.

- Brand new level experience with multiple choices
- Play One-Handed to dominate the continent!
- Unveil the mysteries and experience various strategic gameplays
- Collect and match, unravel the mysteries of the void
- Strengthen your power, and form alliances with others to receive the greatest support!

6741568655.name: Mobile Legends: Bang Bang.US
6741568655.desc:
Mobile Legends: Bang Bang. US - The Ultimate 5v5 MOBA Experience, Now Even Better!

Team up with friends and dive into Mobile Legends: Bang Bang.US, the ultimate 5v5 MOBA showdown where real players clash in thrilling battles! Pick your favorite heroes and assemble the perfect squad with your allies. Enjoy fast-paced 10-second matchmaking and action-packed 10-minute matches, all from the palm of your hand! Master classic MOBA mechanics, like laning, jungling, pushing, and intense team fights—all tailored for a top-tier mobile eSports experience in the U.S.

Game Features:
1. Classic MOBA Action with Enhanced 5v5 Battles
Engage in real-time 5v5 battles against real opponents! Fight across three lanes, conquer four jungle areas, defeat epic bosses, and defend against 18 powerful towers. Everything that makes a true MOBA great is here, now with optimized gameplay for players!

2. Teamwork & Strategy Win the Day
Absorb damage, disrupt enemies, heal teammates—play your role to lead your team to victory! Choose from Tanks, Mages, Marksmen, Assassins, and Supports, with new heroes added regularly. Show off your skills and rise to the top of the ranks!

3. A Fair and Balanced MOBA Experience
Just like the best classic MOBAs, victory in Mobile Legends: Bang Bang.US depends on skill and strategy, not hero training or pay-to-win mechanics. Here, everyone competes on a level playing field—it’s all about your ability to outplay the competition!

4. Intuitive Controls, Effortless Mastery
W

6446197181.name: Glow Fashion Idol
6446197181.desc:
Welcome to Glow Fashion Idol — a fashion makeover and dress-up game where every client has a moment to shine, every look creates a glow-up, and every style choice brings you closer to becoming a Fashion Idol.

CREATE CLIENT GLOW-UPS

Get ready to embrace the glamorous world of Glow Fashion Idol! Step into the spotlight as a talented fashion stylist and create breathtaking outfits for clients in a dazzling dress up and makeover story. Showcase your makeover skills in the makeover studio and rise through the fashion industry.

LIVE YOUR FASHION STORY

Immerse yourself in the captivating fashion story, where you'll encounter exciting challenges, inspiring fashion shows, and a chance to transform into a true fashion idol and super stylist. Express your creativity by putting together incredible glam outfits, each telling a mesmerizing makeover story.

STYLE, CUSTOMIZE & SHINE

With a wide variety of designer outfits and accessories at your fingertips, this dress up game will provide endless possibilities to style and customize your model. Show off your impeccable taste in fashion, dress up in stunning outfits, and let your creativity shine!

KEY FEATURES

• Dress up your virtual models with an extensive wardrobe collection filled with glam outfits.

• Unlock makeup styles and hairstyles to create a signature look in the makeup studio.

• Add friends and join runway events together in the world of fashion.

• Compete in the fashion battle to prove your fashion stylist expertise.

•
6446197181.releaseNotes:
We’re thrilled to unveil the newest update for Glow! Here’s what’s new:

Discover fresh makeup and hair looks, exclusive offers, and new ways to express your style.
And as usual, more improvements & enhancements.

6748342498.name: TopTop: Games & Party
6748342498.desc:
Endless Fun in One App! 
Welcome to TopTop — the ultimate social gaming app where fun meets friendship!
Packed with addictive multiplayer games and exciting ways to connect, TopTop is your go-to place for nonstop entertainment and real-time social interaction.
Play popular games like:
Who’s the Undercover,  Toppy Park,  ONO,  IQ Games, and more!
Whether you're killing time or looking to bond with friends old and new, TopTop brings people together through games — and we’re always adding more!

Toppy Park
Team up for chaos and cooperation in this 2–8 player multiplayer puzzle game! In Toppy Park, teamwork is the only way to win. Work together to solve tricky puzzles and collect all the keys to advance.
Play anytime, anywhere — online or locally — and get ready for laughter, surprises, and unforgettable team moments

Who’s the Undercover?
A game of wits, bluffing, and hilarious deception! Gather your friends online or offline, take on roles as Innocents, the sneaky Undercover, or the clueless Mr. White.  Describe your secret word without giving it away. Can you spot the liar before it’s too late? Enjoy thousands of FREE word packs & hilarious themes! Supports 4-8 player matches, perfect for both online squad battles and offline parties 

Make New Friends
TopTop makes it easy to meet new people while playing. Jump into live PK matches, challenge real-time opponents, and connect with players who share your interests.
Chat, add friends, and invite them for another round anytime!

H

6752929382.name: CozySort: Coins
6752929382.desc:
Dive into the addictive world of CozySort: Coins! Combine matching coins, clear the board, and unlock new shiny types as you climb through endless puzzles. Every move matters — plan your stacks carefully, or you’ll run out of space!
Features:
	• Merge and evolve coins to unlock higher levels.
	• Strategic placement meets satisfying combos.
	• Shuffle, plan, or take risks — every deal is a new challenge.
	• Simple to play, hard to master!
	• Play at your own pace — relaxing yet rewarding gameplay.
Are you ready to stack your way to fortune? Download CozySort: Coins and find out how far your strategy can take you!
6752929382.releaseNotes:
Thank you for playing CozySort: Coins! New update including:
	•	Bug fixes and performance improvements
	•	Optimize user experience

6769314786.name: Food Hunt: Pixel Puzzle
6769314786.desc:
Every level is a pixel art masterpiece. Your ants will devour it - one color at a time.

Food Hunt is a satisfying color sort puzzle where the puzzle board IS the art. Each level presents a hand-crafted pixel art image built entirely from colored blocks. Sort your ants by color, send them in, and watch them eat the picture clean - block by block, until the board is empty and the level is cleared.

HOW TO PLAY
The board is filled with a pixel art image - built entirely from colored blocks. Below the board: your holding slots and block stacks waiting to be tapped.

Tap a block stack to load your ants. They march up and devour every matching colored block in the image. Clear all colors - wipe the board completely - and you win.

But choose your order carefully:

- Holding slots are limited - wrong tap order fills them fast
- Stuck slots = ants can't move = game over
- Plan which color to clear first
- Eat every last block - board empty - level clear!

THE PIXEL ART IS THE PUZZLE
Forget collecting rewards after you win. In Food Hunt, the pixel art image is the challenge itself.

Every level is a different image, built from hundreds of colored blocks. Watch your ants devour it layer by layer, color by color, until nothing remains.

You don't unlock the art. You clear it. And that's exactly what makes it satisfying.

FEATURES
-  200+ color sort puzzle levels -  new images, new challenges
-  Cute ants with ASMR-quality chomping animations
-  Simple one-tap controls - play with one h

icon.alt: Food Hunt: Pixel Puzzle app icon — match3 game by FUNFINITY PTE. LTD

6778082919.name: Dead Rise: Fight to Live
6778082919.desc:
The world has been taken over by zombies, and people are struggling to survive. As a skilled fighter, your mission is to protect survivors and eliminate dangerous enemies.

Explore different locations, complete challenging missions, and use a variety of weapons to fight against zombie attacks. Improve your equipment, sharpen your shooting skills, and face stronger enemies as you progress.

Travel through abandoned cities, forests, and military bases while uncovering new challenges along the way. Every mission requires focus, quick decisions, and accurate shooting.

Play anytime without an internet connection and enjoy an exciting adventure filled with action, survival, and intense battles.
Can you survive and help save the world from the zombie threat?

6772172798.name: Disco Fighters of Dead Streets
6772172798.desc:
Welcome to the ultimate rhythm-action brawler where music is your weapon.
Throw punches, land kicks, and chain devastating combos perfectly synced to a pulsing disco-funk soundtrack. Miss the beat, miss the hit. Master the rhythm, and watch enemies crumble under neon lights. This isn’t just a fighting game, it’s a dance of destruction.
Brawl your way through glowing underground clubs, rooftop arenas, and gritty neon streets. Face rival gangs and epic bosses who attack to the music. Dodge on the snare, strike on the bass, and build your super meter with every perfect hit.

Features:
Rhythm-based combat synced to music
Intense beat 'em up vs multiple enemies
Multiple street levels with rival gangs and bosses
Original electronic, funk, disco soundtrack
Stunning 3D neon visuals
Play offline with no internet required
Every Punch Lands on the Beat.

Download Disco Fighters of Dead Streets  now and prove you rule the neon streets.

6777985510.name: From Pit To Payload
6777985510.desc:
Take control of powerful machines and take on 20 unique missions filled with exciting challenges.
Operate a variety of vehicles, transport resources, lift and move heavy loads, and travel through diverse environments to complete your objectives.Each machine features its own controls and handling style, requiring you to master different operations and adapt to every task.

Every mission introduces a new challenge that tests your precision, timing, and multitasking skills.Handle massive equipment, deliver essential materials, clear work areas, and overcome obstacles across dynamic environments.

As you progress, missions become more demanding, pushing you to improve your control, sharpen your strategy, and master the operation of multiple machines.Complete every job successfully and prove you have what it takes to conquer every challenge.

6780987923.name: Astral Pulse: Fast Tap Arcade
6780987923.desc:
Astral Pulse is a fast-paced arcade game that tests your reaction time and precision. The rules are simple: tap the targets as they appear. As you progress, the speed increases. Miss a tap, and it's game over.

Features:

• Classic Mode: An endless run where the pace constantly accelerates.
• Daily & Weekly Trials: Compete on specific challenges with unique conditions.
• Star Map: Unlock upgrades and modifiers in the constellations to customize the game.
• Game Center Integration: Climb the global leaderboards and see how your reflexes compare against players worldwide.

6778455068.name: Path of Ink
6778455068.desc:
Path of Ink is a fast, beautiful vertical arcade game inspired by Japanese Sumi-e ink painting and brush calligraphy.

Run up the walls as a nimble ink ninja, leap between opposing sides, and slice the numbered lanterns in ascending order to chain massive combos and ignite Fever Mode — all while staying ahead of the rising ink flood below. One missed beat and the ink takes you.

MODES
• Climb — the endless signature run. How high can you rise?
• Daily Ritual — one seeded challenge each day, the same for every player. Keep your streak alive.
• Paths — curated star-mastery trials across ten hand-crafted courses.
• Challenges — mix and match modifiers and build your own run.

COMPETE
• Global Game Center leaderboards — climb the world rankings in Climb and the Daily Ritual.

A GAME THAT RESPECTS YOU
• No ads. No tracking. No nonsense.
• Free to play, with a single optional one-time unlock — no subscriptions, no loot boxes.
• Thoughtful accessibility: haptics, a reduced-ink mode, and a left-handed layout.

Beautifully rendered on textured rice paper with bold black and crimson brush strokes, Path of Ink turns split-second reflexes into living calligraphy.

Find your flow. Paint your path.

6776776722.name: SnapSeven
6776776722.desc:
SnapSeven turns photos into seven-word fragment puzzles. Look at the picture, combine the fragments, and discover every hidden word.

Play a new daily puzzle, revisit archive puzzles, and unlock themed packs when you want more. Choose an easy or hard variant, switch between 14 supported languages, and use hints when a word gets stuck.

SnapSeven is built for short, focused word puzzle sessions with real photo clues and a clean fragment board.

Optional SnapSeven Plus is a monthly auto-renewing subscription that unlocks all packs and the archive. The app shows the localized App Store price before purchase, and the subscription can be managed or canceled in App Store account settings.

Optional hint packs are available for players who want extra help.

Privacy Policy and Support: https://littlegolem.net/public/snapcross-privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

6781955957.name: Lumiciin
6781955957.desc:
Channel the dying Aether. Survive the Grid.

Lumiciin is a neon arena-survival game with a twist: you don't shoot, you draw lightning. Slide your finger through a chain of same-colored energy nodes — release to detonate a chain of lightning that strikes every enemy of that color on the field. Longer chains, bigger booms.

When you start drawing, Aether Focus kicks in — time slows around you so you can plan the perfect chain while your Conduit keeps dodging. Strategic, comfortable, and one-thumb friendly.

FEATURES
• Three playable Conduits with distinct stats and lore — Volt, Surge, and Flux
• Campaign across four neon zones, each capped by a unique boss
• Endless mode with a local leaderboard
• Daily Rift — one seed shared by everyone for that day, one shot to climb the wave count
• 20+ in-run upgrades that stack into wildly different builds (chain echo, shorter chains, freeze, mirror cast, drain, and more)
• Meta progression: spend Aether shards on a persistent skill tree, unlock new Conduits
• 28-entry Codex of world lore, bestiary and zones
• Pure neon: glowing chains, particle storms, electric ambience

The Grid persists. Will you?

6776850027.name: 路地裏の遺言
6776850027.desc:
雨上がりの夕暮れ、古い飲み屋街〈蛇骨小路〉で、一人の少女が遺体となって見つかった。事故か、それとも――。
探偵助手の少年・灯司が彼女の手に見つけたのは、最期まで握りしめられた一枚の古い写真と、「願いを呑む井戸」という小路の言い伝えだった。

ひとつの殺人事件から、二十年前に封じられた失踪事件の真相へ。聞き込み、証言、そして残された写真を手がかりに、あなた自身が犯人とトリックを推理していく、本格ミステリー・サウンドノベル。

◆ 物語
二十年前に忽然と消えた地上げ屋。井戸が連れ去ったという不気味な噂。そして、街の誰からも「小路の母」と慕われる女将が、たった一人で抱え続けてきた秘密――。
すべての糸が手繰り寄せられたとき、路地裏に沈められた「遺言」が明らかになる。それは、誰かを守るために罪を背負った、ある人物の悲しい真実だった。

◆ こんな方におすすめ
・本格的な推理・ミステリー・サスペンスが好きな方
・探偵ものや、事件の謎解きをじっくり楽しみたい方
・伏線と、その回収・どんでん返しに痺れたい方
・読み応えのあるノベルゲーム／サウンドノベルが好きな方
・昭和レトロな下町・和風の世界観が好きな方
・泣ける、重厚な人間ドラマを求めている方

◆ 特長
・全編を貫く一本の大きな謎と、その真相
・美麗な一枚絵の背景とキャラクター立ち絵
・場面を彩るオリジナルBGMと効果音
・片手でタップして読み進められるシンプルな操作
・選択を迫られない、物語に集中できる一本道シナリオ

登場人物たちの想いが交差し、二十年の時を越えて、ひとつの真実にたどり着く。
あなたは、その結末を見届けられるだろうか。

※ 本作はフィクションです。実在の人物・団体・事件とは一切関係ありません。

6781281522.name: Marqueo
6781281522.desc:
Marqueo is a carnival wheel arcade you can play anytime, fully offline.

Spin the wheel and jump into quick skill mini-games: Coin Flip, Star Hunt, Pick One, and Encore Spin. Earn stars and tickets, build combos, and unlock wheel frames, backgrounds, and themes in the Collection.

Play at your own pace in Free Stage, chase a high score in Show Run, try the daily featured mini-game in Spotlight, or pass the device around with 2–4 players in Party Pass. Track your stats, personal records, and recent spins.

No real money - just timing, reflexes, and arcade fun.

6780788243.name: Market Rover
6780788243.desc:
Can you survive the volatility?

Market Rover transforms financial markets into a thrilling off-road adventure. Every hill, dip, rally, and crash becomes part of the terrain as you navigate a rover across a constantly changing chart landscape.

6780714595.name: Donut Drop
6780714595.desc:
◆◇ ゲームタイトル：DONUT-DROP（ドーナツ・ドロップ） ◇◆

画面上部から落ちてくる、カラフルで美味しそうなドーナツたちを綺麗に並べて消していく、爽快カジュアルパズルゲーム！

従来の無機質なブロックゲームとは異なり、ポップで親しみやすい「ドーナツ」をモチーフにしたモダンなビジュアルが特徴です。今回のアップデートでは、待望の「AI対戦モード」や「触覚フィードバック（バイブレーション）」が追加され、楽しさと爽快感が大幅にパワーアップしました！

【ゲームの特徴】
● 魅力的なデザイン：多彩なフレーバーのドーナツたちが画面を華やかに彩ります。
● 【新機能】最新AI対戦：最新AIアルゴリズムを搭載したコンピュータとの対戦モードを搭載！1人でのスコアアタックだけでなく、奥深い頭脳戦バトルが楽しめます。
● 快適な操作性：タップでのオブジェクト回転、左右スワイプでの移動、下スワイプでの即時落下など、モバイルデバイスに最適化されたスマートな操作感を実現。
● 【パワーアップ】爽快な演出と臨場感：ラインを揃えて消した際のはじけるビジュアルエフェクトや心地よいサウンドに加え、iPhoneのバイブレーション（触覚フィードバック）に対応！コンボが決まった瞬間、手のひらに極上の爽快感が伝わります。
● 安心の仕様：面倒なユーザー登録やオンラインログインは一切不要。起動してすぐに楽しめます。
● ローカルハイスコア記録：ご自身の過去最高スコアが端末内に自動で保存されるため、いつでも自己ベスト更新にチャレンジできます。

【こんな方におすすめ】
・通勤・通学などの隙間時間にサクッと脳トレや気分転換をしたい方
・ポップで可愛いビジュアルのカジュアルゲームが好きな方
・最新のAIコンピュータと手軽にパズル対戦を楽しみたい方
・直感的でテンポの良い、臨場感のあるパズルアクションを求めている方

画面いっぱいに広がるドーナツを上手にコントロールして、ハイスコアとAIへの勝利を目指しましょう！今すぐ『DONUT-DROP』の進化した世界を体験してみてください！

新機能である「AI対戦」と、前回実装したこだわりの「バイブレーション（Taptic Engine）」の魅力がしっかりと伝わる内容に仕上げています。今回のアップデート申請も無事に通過することを応援しております！
6780714595.releaseNotes:
【バージョン 1.10 の最新情報】
待望の大型アップデート！さらに楽しく、さらに爽快に進化しました！

● AI対戦モードの追加：最新のAIアルゴリズムを搭載したコンピュータとの熱い対戦機能を実装！あなたのパズルスキルで手強いAIに勝利しよう！
● 触覚フィードバック（バイブレーション）対応：ドーナツが消えた瞬間やコンボが決まった時に、iPhoneが心地よく連動して振動！手のひらから伝わる圧倒的な爽快感をお楽しみください。
● GAME CENTERへの最高スコア、最高ライン数、最高コンボ数、最高撃破Lvの登録・ランキング
● 不具合の修正：より快適でスムーズにプレイできるよう、いくつかの細かなバグを修正しました。

6780236483.name: Color Pixel Numbers Game
6780236483.desc:
Color Pixel Numbers is a simple and relaxing pixel art coloring app made for quick, satisfying creative play.

Start with ready-made quests, import your own photos, or continue unfinished artwork from My Arts. Each image becomes a numbered pixel canvas that you can zoom, move, and color at your own pace.

Features:
- Play simple pixel coloring quests
- Import photos and turn them into pixel art
- Zoom in to see numbered cells clearly
- Swipe with the brush to color faster
- Save completed and in-progress artwork in My Arts
- No account or sign-up required
- Optional coins for helpful coloring tools
- Optional Remove Ads purchase

Color Pixel Numbers is designed to be easy to understand, calm to play, and fun to return to whenever you want a short creative break.

Your imported photos and artwork are stored locally on your device. Some features may include optional ads or in-app purchases.

6780895008.name: Home Inventory Organizer
6780895008.desc: Bring order and clarity to your home with Home Inventory Organizer, a smart and beautiful way to track and manage your belongings. Create a detailed inventory of items, organize everything by rooms and categories, and explore your home through an intuitive visual map. Monitor your organization level, discover areas for improvement, and stay motivated with progress milestones and achievements. A clean design, helpful insights, and rewarding progression turn everyday organization into a satisfying habit.

6778259127.desc:
Can you build the perfect season?

20-0 is a free pro football roster-builder game. Spin the slot machine, land on an all-time team and era, and draft the best player you can into each position. Fill out your squad, simulate the season, and find out if your roster can go a perfect 20-0 — 17 regular-season wins plus a 3-game playoff run to the title.

HOW TO PLAY
• Spin to land on a team and a ~5-year era
• Draft the best available player into an open position slot
• Build your roster across offense and defense
• Simulate the season and chase a flawless 20-0

GAME MODES
• Classic — player stats on view as you draft
• Gridiron IQ — stats hidden; draft from memory and instinct
• Choose offense-only or a full roster (both sides of the ball)

DAILY CHALLENGE
Everyone gets the same spins once a day. Compare your record on the global leaderboard and keep your daily streak alive.

PLAY ONLINE
• Challenge a friend to the exact same spins, head-to-head
• Drop into casual public pools and play at your own pace
• Climb the ranked ladder against players worldwide

TRACK YOUR LEGACY
Create a free account to save your runs, track your streak, and chase your all-time bests.

Think you can assemble a roster of legends and run the table? Spin it up and go 20-0.

—
20-0 is an independent fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the NFL or any professional football league or team. All player and team references are used for identification and commentary purposes only.

6778532662.name: Ace's High Deuce's Low
6778532662.desc:
Aces High, Deuces Low is a relaxing solitaire card game that is simple yet challenging. Choose a card stack and decide whether the next card drawn will be higher or lower. Easy, right? 

Play all the cards from the draw pile to win!

Game Features
► Simple Gameplay: Easy to play. Fun to master.
► Relaxing: Play at your pace. No timers.
► Nearly Endless Levels: How many levels can you complete?
► Cards and Playmats: Multiple card and playmat themes are available.

Aces High, Deuces Low offers a relaxing and rewarding experience where you make the call; Higher or Lower?

6779665385.name: Acey Rooms
6779665385.desc:
Acey Rooms is a local multiplayer card game for playing Acey Deucey with friends nearby. Create a room, let nearby players join from their own iPhones, and play a full table using social chips only.

Each room keeps the game moving with a clear turn flow: draw the first card, draw the second, choose Ace high or low when needed, enter a chip amount, and reveal the middle card. Acey Rooms tracks the pot, current turn, player stacks, game progress, and final results so the group can focus on the table.

Features:
- Nearby room discovery over Bluetooth and the local network
- Local display names and room names
- Game, Players, Settings, and Results tabs
- Host controls for starting, managing, and ending a room
- Chip totals, round notices, and final results
- No account required for nearby-room play
- Works without internet for local rooms

Acey Rooms is for casual social card play. Chips have no cash value. Chips cannot be bought, sold, cashed out, redeemed for prizes, or used for real-money betting. The app has no in-app purchases, ads, subscriptions, prizes, cash-out, or developer-facilitated wagering.

6615086509.name: NYT Crossplay: Word Games
6615086509.desc:
Play with friends, compete and connect in Crossplay, the first 2-player word game from NYT Games that blends socializing and strategy. Play distraction-free and build words with letter tiles. Use built-in tools to learn, improve and win, or simply enjoy the challenge of this multiplayer game.

App Features:

PLAY
• Take turns placing letter tiles on a shared word game board.
• Build words and rack up points with easy-to-play, focused gameplay.
• No in-app ads. Focus on your word game strategy.

CONNECT
• Easily play word games with friends and family.
• Share strategies and friendly banter with in-game chats.
• Grab your letter tiles and go word-to-word in this multiplayer game.

COMPETE
• Start a friendly competition and climb the leaderboard.
• Play multiple word games against friends or random opponents simultaneously.
• Get matched up with equal opponents.

IMPROVE
• Get tips from Cross Bot after every 2-player game and computer game.
• Spell and sharpen your word game skills against the computer.

LEARN 
• Expand your vocabulary with the word of the day and a built-in dictionary.
• Check your game history and review your thewords you made on the game board.

STATS
• Track your progress and lifetime stats, including wins and losses, average scores, longest words and more.

BY DOWNLOADING THE NEW YORK TIMES CROSSPLAY APP, you agree to:
• The New York Times Privacy Policy: https://www.nytimes.com/privacy/privacy-policy
• The New York Times Cookie Policy: https://www.nytimes
6615086509.releaseNotes:
This version contains improvements to keep Crossplay running smoothly.

Have feedback? Email us. 
nytgames@nytimes.com

6762342518.name: Fluffy Drop
6762342518.desc:
Fluffy Drop – A Cozy Puzzle Adventure Where Every Drop Counts!

Step into the softest puzzle experience with Fluffy Drop, a delightful blend of color-matching strategy and satisfying drag-and-drop mechanics. Your mission is simple yet irresistibly engaging: guide fluffy balls into matching color zones, clear the board, and bask in the joy of perfectly planned moves. Whether you're a puzzle enthusiast or just looking for a relaxing brain break, Fluffy Drop wraps logic in charm and challenges in comfort. 

Why you’ll fall in love with Fluffy Drop:

Satisfying Drag & Drop Gameplay – Simple to learn, yet deeply rewarding to master.

Hundreds of Cozy Levels – From gentle warm-ups to brain-teasing puzzles, there’s always a new challenge waiting.

Vibrant Visuals & Soothing Animations – Every color match comes to life with soft effects and smooth motion.

Strategic Depth – Plan your moves, anticipate the next drop, and create chain reactions for maximum satisfaction.

6781540251.name: いきものの島
6781540251.desc:
ある日、小さな島に空想のいきものたちがやってきました。
あなたは、その島を見守る「神様」です。

やることは、基本ぼーっと眺めるだけ。
いきものたちは気質のままに暮らし、食べ物を集め、家を建て、村から町へ、やがて文明へと、自分たちの力で島を育てていきます。アプリを閉じている間も時間は進み、久しぶりに開くと島はすっかり様変わり。「おかえりなさい」の島の歩みを、年代記でふり返るのも楽しみのひとつです。

■ ただ眺めるだけ。それが気持ちいい
ドット絵のいきものたちが、朝も夜も、晴れの日も嵐の日も、島の上をてくてく歩き回ります。やわらかいパステルの世界と、移ろう空と海。BGMを流して、ぼーっと癒されてください。

■ 神様の力で、ちょっとだけ介入
見ているだけじゃ物足りないときは、神様の力を。
・天罰（落雷・台風）で島に試練を
・恵み（癒しの光・恵みの雨）で島を祝福
ふりかかる縄張り争いや自然災害を、見守るも助けるもあなた次第です。

■ ガチャで新しい仲間を
島で貯まる「タマゴ」で、専用のいきものを迎えられます（課金ではありません）。レアリティが上がるほど姿は特別になり、最高レアの伝説のいきものは島に祝福と守りをもたらします。

■ 血統で生まれる、世界にひとつのいきもの
4つの基礎種が混ざり合い、見た目も気質もちがう新種が次々と誕生。発見したいきものは「ずかん」に記録されます。

■ あなたにやさしい設計
・完全オフライン（位置情報・通信なし）
・広告なし／アプリ内課金なし（買い切り）
・放置でじっくり、無限に育つ島

今日も、いきものたちの島をのぞいてみませんか。

6782363654.desc:
숫자로 즐기는 가장 깔끔한 두뇌 퍼즐, 스도쿠.

[주요 기능]
- 4단계 난이도: 쉬움 / 보통 / 어려움 / 전문가
- 오늘의 도전: 매일 새로운 퍼즐로 연속 기록(스트릭) 쌓기
- 메모 모드: 셀에 후보 숫자를 적으며 논리적으로 풀기
- 되돌리기 / 다시하기 / 지우기로 자유로운 실수 교정
- 힌트 기능으로 막힐 때 한 수 도움받기

6780328280.name: Clear Sand! Color Puzzle

Clear Sand! Color Puzzle is a vibrant puzzle experience where the soothing flow of sand meets clever sorting logic. Step into a beautiful world of rich color layers, charming designs, and calming visual effects. Simply tap, gather, and organize every hue into its perfect match.

Gameplay Overview:
In Clear Sand! Color Puzzle, your mission is to tap and collect colored sand from various unique shapes, then guide each color into the designated boxes above. Plan your strategy wisely, manage your temporary slots efficiently, and keep your board from locking up. It is easy to pick up, but every new stage introduces complex layouts and fresh color palettes to test your logic.

Game Features:
- Satisfying Sand Sorting: Tap to collect rich, fluid sand from playful containers and distribute them into the correct boxes.
- ASMR Relaxation: Enjoy seamless touch controls, peaceful visuals, and deeply satisfying sand physics on every level.
- Tactical Logic Puzzles: Sharpen your mind by planning ahead, managing limited spaces, and keeping your lanes clear.
- Power-Up Boosters: Unlock helpful tools to get past tricky setups and keep your sorting streak alive.
- Stunning Creative Themes: Discover a wide variety of beautifully crafted objects, shapes, and color schemes that keep the gameplay fresh.
- Accessible Yet Challenging: Master the intuitive tap mechanics instantly, then face deeper, multi-layered puzzles as you progress.

Why You Will Love It:
Clear Sand! Color Puzzle perfectly balanc

6779126039.name: Match Juliens
6779126039.desc:
Meet Julien — the funny, smart 7-month-old cat who inspired this game! 
Match Juliens is a colourful match-3 puzzle game featuring five adorable cat characters. Swap and match tiles to hit your score goals, unlock new themes, and dress your cats in fun costumes like a witch hat, space helmet, neon shades, and a pink tutu.
FEATURES
• Classic match-3 gameplay — easy to learn, hard to put down
• 5 unique cat characters with their own personalities
• Unlockable themes: Classic, Halloween, Galaxy, Neon & Pastel
• Costume accessories for your cats
• Earn Cat Coins as you play and spend them on new themes
• Relaxing yet challenging — perfect for all ages
Whether you're a puzzle pro or just looking for something fun to play, Match Juliens brings the charm of a real cat (specifically Julien) to your pocket.
Download for free and start matching!

6783339261.name: Midnight Telescope
6783339261.desc:
Midnight Telescope is a starry sky telescope-themed observation and memory challenge game. You need to move the telescope lens to find specific mahjong tile patterns on a hidden board and quickly tap the correct target when it appears.

Each round presents a target tile. The patterns on the board are hidden by the night, with only the areas the lens passes over illuminated. You need to rely on observation, judgment, and memory to find the correct answer within a limited time or opportunity.

Gameplay Features:
Move the telescope lens to gradually reveal hidden tiles.
Find matching patterns on the board based on the top target tile.
Tap the correct target to score points; tapping the wrong target deducts chances or time.
Four modes: Classic, Time, Memory, and Endless.

Memory mode: Memorize the tile first, then find the target from memory.

Endless mode: Challenge yourself to achieve consecutive hits.

Records best scores, fastest completion times, and total number of tiles found.

Adjustable lens size and supports sound effects and haptic settings.

Midnight Telescope uses mahjong tile patterns as visual recognition elements. The core experience is an observation, memory, and reaction challenge; it does not include mahjong games or gambling content.

6782953543.name: Indizio!
6782953543.desc:
Indizio! e il gioco di parole perfetto da fare in compagnia: a tempo, semplice e divertentissimo.

Un giocatore guarda la parola e la fa indovinare ai compagni con indizi, sinonimi e gesti, senza mai pronunciarla! Quante ne indovinate prima che scada il tempo?

- Modalita Classica: gioca contro il tempo e batti il tuo record.
- Modalita Crescente: si parte facile e si sale di difficolta.
- Sfida a squadre: fino a 6 squadre, a turno, con classifica finale.
- Centinaia di parole italiane in tante categorie e tre livelli di difficolta.
- Crea le tue liste di parole personalizzate per serate a tema.
- Statistiche e record salvati sul dispositivo.
- Suoni e vibrazione configurabili.

100% offline, senza pubblicita, senza account e senza raccolta di dati. Perfetto per feste, viaggi in macchina, cene tra amici e serate in famiglia.

Prendi il telefono e cerca l'intesa!

6782306468.name: 邊界白目日常
6782306468.desc:
《邊界白目日常》是一款可愛又有點欠的 2D 拖曳解謎遊戲。畫面被一條發光邊界分成甜點粉左世界與灰藍正經右世界，每一邊都有不同規則。
玩家要把小動物與物件拖回正確區域，處理排隊、通行章、安靜區、臨時通行、錯邊警告等事件。每關會抽出多個小事件，完成全部事件即可解鎖一張貼紙卡。
遊戲特色：
左右世界不同規則，短時間內就能理解。
拖曳小動物與物件，錯邊會立刻提示。
規則每隔一段時間切換，節奏輕快。
Stamp、Tape、Whistle 三種工具幫你把白目邊界壓回去。
通關解鎖可保存與分享的貼紙卡。
八關完整流程，包含教學、關卡選擇、貼紙冊、設定與結案畫面。
這不是嚴肅邊境管理，是一場甜點街和正經街之間的可愛混亂整理術。

6780989548.name: Carnival Knockdown
6780989548.seller: Fortune Mine Oyun Yazilim Anonim Sirketi
6780989548.desc:
Welcome to the big top! The show is about to start, and YOU are the main star!

In Carnival Knockdown, your goal is crystal clear: use the Cannon to hit and knock down every object on the platform! Tap the screen, make your shot, and enjoy this satisfying physics-based destruction. But be careful; you have a limited number of shots! To clear all the targets, you need to find the perfect angle and build your strategy.

GAME FEATURES:

One-Tap Action: Just tap the screen and fire your cannonball. Easy to learn, hard to master!

Dynamic Physics & Materials: Every object reacts differently! Send light wood flying, push heavy iron, smash glass jars (with a satisfying ASMR feel!), or slide icy blocks!

Stunning Carnival Theme: Hundreds of levels filled with colorful graphics and fun animations.

Are you ready to knock down everything on the stand and become the star of the show? Aim, fire, and beat the fun levels in Carnival Knockdown!

Download now and let the destruction begin!

6780831457.name: Lumio Wild 4D
6780831457.desc:
Lumio Wild 4D mang đến trải nghiệm khám phá thế giới động vật hoàn toàn mới với công nghệ thực tế tăng cường (AR).

CHỨC NĂNG NỔI BẬT

• Quét thẻ để hiện mô hình động vật 3D sống động
• Khám phá 25 loài động vật hoang dã phổ biến
• Tương tác với động vật và nghe tiếng kêu chân thực
• Tìm hiểu môi trường sống, thức ăn và nhiều thông tin thú vị
• Ghép thẻ thức ăn để kích hoạt hiệu ứng ăn
• Trò chơi đố vui giúp bé học mà chơi
• Giao diện thân thiện, phù hợp với trẻ em

Lumio Wild 4D giúp trẻ em khám phá thiên nhiên một cách trực quan và sinh động ngay tại nhà.

Yêu cầu sử dụng:
• Trải nghiệm miễn phí với 5 loài động vật
• Bộ thẻ Lumio Wild 4D để trải nghiệm đầy đủ
• Camera trên thiết bị

6783292227.name: RemaDivi
6783292227.desc:
When the logic behind the numbers suddenly clicks, a quiet confidence emerges—not from rote memorization of formulas, but from truly grasping why a remainder lands where it does. RemaDivi was created for that very moment.

Turn Division into a Journey of Discovery

Step into a vibrant, light-filled puzzle world where every move is a mini-exercise in logic. Place number cards onto the grid to match target remainders, transforming abstract division into a tangible, fun, and deeply rewarding experience.
From accessible introductory levels to the ultimate challenge of the "Grand Master Gate," every stage encourages thoughtful reflection rather than rushed action.

A Journey Worth Taking
Explore hundreds of meticulously crafted campaign levels across five stunning regions. Unlock new territories on the map, earn star ratings, and prove that persistence itself is a mark of wisdom.

Learn at Your Own Pace
Eight guided lessons delve into concepts like division, remainders, and modular arithmetic thinking—each followed by a quick quiz to reinforce your learning. Freely explore the "Remainder Workshop" whenever you like, without pressure or judgment.

Play Your Way
Tackle fresh, date-generated "Daily Challenges"; race against the clock in "Speed ​​Rush" mode to set new win streaks; or hone your skills in "Training Mode" by exploring pattern-based puzzles and complex layouts. No matter your learning stage, this game adapts perfectly to your needs.

Truly Yours, Always
Your game progress

6783244533.name: Farm Puzzle Logic
6783244533.desc:
This is a casual puzzle game with a lively pace, simple controls, and a growing sense of achievement the more you play. Players need to observe the block arrangement and route layout inside the maze, choose the right movement order for each block, and help them leave the maze smoothly. The gameplay is simple and intuitive, but completing each level also requires a bit of planning and thinking.

The levels progress from easy to challenging. Early stages are simple to pick up, while later levels gradually introduce more difficulty. You need to plan each move carefully, avoid blocks getting in each other’s way, and find a more efficient way to complete the level. Whether you want to relax for a few minutes or take on a greater challenge, you can find your own pace here.

The game also includes a leaderboard system. You can keep improving your results, challenge higher rankings, and see if you can reach the top of the leaderboard. Every completed level and every improvement in performance can help you move one step higher.

There is also a cute pet-growing system in the game. By completing levels and daily tasks, you can unlock pets, raise them, and let them grow with you. Pets not only make the gameplay more enjoyable, but also add a stronger sense of companionship and collection fun to your journey.

Simple and intuitive maze gameplay, easy to pick up and suitable for all types of players.
Rich level designs, progressing step by step from relaxing experiences to strategic chall

6760320099.name: FIFA Heroes: Football Action
6760320099.desc:
FIFA Heroes – Arcade Football With Superpowers

Step onto the pitch like never before in FIFA Heroes, the ultimate arcade football game where every match is packed with supercharged action, unique powers, and fast-paced fun. Forget the slow build-up of traditional football – here it’s 5v5 battles, 90 second matches, and nonstop thrills.

Whether you’re pulling off a teleport dribble, blasting a flaming power shot, or using a magnetic tackle to steal the ball, every Hero on your team has special abilities that turn the game upside down. Build your squad, master their skills, and dominate the competition in a brand-new way to play the world’s favorite sport.

Key Features

- Arcade Football Reimagined – No 90-minute grind. Matches are short, explosive, and filled with unpredictable moments. Perfect for gaming on the go.
- Build Your Hero Squad – Collect and upgrade a roster of unique football heroes, each with distinct powers, playstyles, and strengths. Find your perfect combo of striker, defender, midfielder, or all-rounder.
- Superpowers That Change the Game – Freeze opponents in their tracks, unleash unstoppable shots, teleport across the pitch, or shield your goal with magical barriers. The pitch is your playground.
- Global PvP Matches – Take your team online and challenge players worldwide. Climb the ranked leagues from Wooden League to Platinum and beyond, earning rewards, glory, and bragging rights.
- Season Pass Content – Unlock exclusive profile avatars, borders, emoj

6756288168.name: Cookingo: Perfect Meal
6756288168.desc:
Welcome to Cookingo, your peaceful little escape from the hustle and bustle of everyday life. In this game, cooking is more than just making food—it’s a foodie haven, where you can savor each calm and happy moment.

Your mission is simple: craft all the fresh ingredients into delightful creations.
- Chop & Slice: Feel your rhythm as you softly slice fruits and veggies.
- Whisk & Mix: Watch colors swirl and textures blend while soothing ASMR sounds wrap around you like a cozy blanket.
- Perfect Plating: Sprinkle spices, drizzle sauces, and add the finishing touches to turn every dish into a masterpiece.

Tiny sweet touches that make Cookingo your hideaway:
- Relaxing sounds that help you unwind and breathe a little easier.
- Adorable, visually enchanting dishes—each recipe has its own dreamy story.
- Made for everyone, whether you’re a food enthusiast, a casual gamer, or someone who simply loves cozy pleasures.

So, what are you waiting for? Turn your screen into a cozy kitchen, and let every cooking moment melt away your stress.

6444112366.name: Limbus Company
6444112366.desc:
▶ A Combination of Turn-based RPG and Realtime Brawl

Each turn results in a display of exhilarating action.
In the combat phase, units on both sides will act simultaneously.
During the scramble, characters targeting each other may Clash.
The outcome of a Clash depends on the strength of their opposing skills and a sprinkle of luck; the winner can shut down the loser's skill.
Ensure you use the right skills to win Clashes.

▶ Single-handed Skirmishing

Connect skill icons across the grid, and your units will take action according to your commands.
Chaining skills of the same color allows you to deal greater damage.
Using simple and practical controls, watch as the Sinners dance to your tempo.




▶ Create Diverse Strategies with Identities and E.G.O

Form teams of Identities and equip them with an arsenal of E.G.O that will create powerful synergies.
Your foes come armed with a variety of Affinity-based attacks and tricky effects.
In particular, Abnormalities are formidable foes that may prove to be considerable challenges.
Learn their behavior and weaknesses, and compose the right team to eventually conquer them.



▶ Immerse Yourself in the World of Project Moon

From the creators of Lobotomy Corporation and Library of Ruina, another tale set in the same, unique world unfolds.
In this massive dystopian metropolis, you will embark on a journey to find Golden Boughs with a cast of 12 Sinners.
Enjoy a gripping story and the series of events that await.
All dialogue in the main

6744975195.name: Sled Surfers
6744975195.desc:
SLIDE fast as you can!
Race through snowy slopes in Sled Surfers, the ultimate winter SLEDDING GAME!

DODGE trees, leap over ice, and grab power-ups as you speed downhill.
Slide through snow into mountains, forests, cities, subways, caves, and beyond.

Inspired by ENDLESS RUNNER hits, Sled Surfers delivers FAST action, SMOOTH controls, and endless FUN.

Features:

Simple to play, hard to master.
Download now and ride the snow!

6784436170.name: QorvellaFriy
6784436170.desc:
ein vollständig offline spielbares Strategiespiel mit rundenbasierten Gefechten auf einem Rasterfeld. Im Mittelpunkt stehen taktische Entscheidungen, unterschiedliche Einheitenrollen, elementare Wechselwirkungen, Schild- und Lebenspunktverwaltung sowie ein kartenbasiertes Fähigkeitssystem. Jede Partie verbindet Positionsspiel, gezielte Eliminierung gegnerischer Einheiten und den Aufbau einer wirksamen Zusammenstellung aus Wächtereinheiten, Relikten und Runenkarten.

Die Spielstruktur kombiniert einzelne Kämpfe mit verzweigten Wegentscheidungen, Ereignissen, Elite-Begegnungen und Bossphasen. Karten, Relikte und Einheiten greifen ineinander und erzeugen in jeder Chronik neue Kombinationen. Fortschritt, Freischaltungen, Statistiken und Verlauf werden lokal gespeichert. Eine Verbindung zum Internet ist nicht erforderlich.

Besondere Merkmale sind die Verbindung aus Rastertaktik und Kartenmechanik, ein mehrstufiges Fortschrittssystem mit dauerhaftem Meta-Fortschritt, mehrere Schwierigkeitsgrade, eine integrierte Anleitung, eine Enzyklopädie für Inhalte sowie eine auf Mobilgeräte angepasste Oberfläche im Hochformat. Die App ist auf wiederholtes Spielen ausgelegt und bietet durch zufällige Entwicklungen, unterschiedliche Pfade und variable Teamzusammenstellungen eine hohe spielerische Vielfalt.

6767490804.name: Number Garden: Math for Kids
6767490804.desc:
Number Garden is a calm, Montessori-inspired math adventure for young learners (about ages 3–6). Children explore numbers through short, focused rounds with immediate feedback — so practice feels like play, not pressure.

PICK A SKILL, GROW CONFIDENCE
Choose from 15 practice topics, each broken into levels you can revisit. Earn stars as you improve and watch skills build step by step.

WHAT KIDS PRACTICE
* Counting — "How many do you see?"
* Matching — connect a number to the right-sized groups
* Sorting — put numbers in order
* Addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division — friendly multiple-choice practice
* Missing number — finish a sequence
* Odd or even — quick classification
* Counting coins — add up simple coin values
* Number words — connect digits and words (with language options)
* Tell time — read the clock hands
* Fractions — identify how much is shaded
* Measuring — length, height, mass & capacity
* Number bonds — parts that make a whole

DESIGNED FOR FAMILIES
* Gentle visuals and a relaxed pace - great for kids who are sensitive to overstimulating apps
* Optional music and sound effects (you can adjust what feels right at home)
* Progress and scores are kept on your device for a simple, private experience
* This app collects no data — rated for ages 3+

WORKS OFFLINE, NO ADS
* Number Garden is fully offline with all sounds and assets bundled in, so practice can happen anywhere—without ads or internet, ever.
* Whether you're supporting early number sense o

6762112082.name: Pixel Bus: Color Match
6762112082.desc:
Pixel Bus Color Match brings a fresh twist to classic puzzle games by combining bus jam challenges with smooth color flow mechanics.

Move your bus through a crowded scene, pick up passengers of the same color, and clear each level with perfect timing. Every decision matters as you manage the flow and avoid picking the wrong colors.

This is more than just a puzzle game , it designed to relax your mind while keeping you engaged.

How to Play

Move the bus through the crowd
Pick up passengers that match your color
Fill the bus to complete the level

Game Features

Unique blend of traffic jam and sorting mechanics
Smooth and satisfying gameplay
Easy controls with addictive puzzle levels
Relaxing visuals and clean design
Increasing challenge with new layouts and colors

Whether you enjoy color sort puzzles, traffic games, or satisfying flow mechanics, Pixel Bus offers a fun and relaxing experience.

Start solving the jam and master the perfect flow!

6758348999.name: The Big Con
6758348999.desc:
Hustle and grift your way across America in the ‘90s as a teenage con artist on a crime-filled road trip adventure!

Play as Ali, a curious and sarcastic high schooler who ditches band camp to go on a cross-country road trip. But this isn’t a joyride! Ali is on an all-important mission to save her family video store from the nasty loan sharks trying to shut their shop down.

Swindle strangers, pickpocket people, and con commoners across a wacky America of the ‘90s. And – it should go without saying – lie to your mom about all of it. Choose who deserves to be conned and who might need a helping hand. The world is your oyster (and hey, pearls are worth a lot!).

One Con Doesn’t Fool All

Con people your way! Wear disguises, sneak around, eavesdrop on conversations, and learn how to approach each mark. Maybe you think you can make enough cheddar just by pickpocketing. Or seek out more complex grifts that involve breaking and entering, smooth talking, and more. It’s up to you to outsmart everyone and lockpick everything that stands between you and saving your mom's video store.

A Coming-of-Age Comedy

If there’s one surefire way to discover yourself, it’s by setting out on an adventure. Luckily for you, you’ve got the aid of an expert grifter to coach you in the elusive art of charm. But a life of crime is no laughing matter! Not unless you turn on the laugh track and make it a criminally funny sitcom. Get ready to talk your way into deals, hearts, and trouble. And don’t forget

6781195701.name: The Kardashev Initiative
6781195701.desc:
Every civilization is measured by the energy it commands. Yours begins with one world, one star, and a choice.

THE KARDASHEV INITIATIVE is a hard science-fiction civilization roguelite. Guide your species from its first orbital stations to the energy of an entire galaxy — or watch it join the silent majority that never made it.

A COMPLETE SAGA IN 15 MINUTES
Each run compresses a thousand years of history into one session. Technologies emerge, colonies spread, crises ignite — and every ending, triumph or extinction, writes a chronicle worth keeping.

DECISIONS, NOT MICROMANAGEMENT
You won't shuffle build queues. You'll face the decisions that define a civilization: fund the Dyson swarm or militarize its budget. Liberate the AGI or cage it. Terraform the living world or preserve it. Your choices set flags history remembers — and their consequences return generations later.

THE GREAT FILTER IS WAITING
The galaxy is old, vast, and silent. Every run hides a Filter tuned to your civilization's weakness: its machines, its biosphere, its armies, or its own cohesion. Reaching Kardashev III means surviving what silenced everyone else.

MANY ROADS TO VICTORY, MANY WAYS TO DIE
Declare completeness at Type II. Finish a megastructure Great Work. Merge with your machines. Or gamble everything on the climb to Type III — knowing most who try are remembered only as quiet ruins.

HARD SCIENCE FICTION, PLAYED STRAIGHT
Dyson swarms built from dismantled planets. Wormhole gates showing lensed s

6781234508.name: Arrow Puzzle: Maze Escape Go
6781234508.desc:
Challenge your mind with a fun and relaxing puzzle adventure!

Arrow Puzzle: Maze Escape Go is an engaging logic game where every move matters. Study the arrows, find the correct path, and clear the board by solving clever puzzles designed to test your thinking skills.

Easy to learn but challenging to master, the game offers satisfying gameplay, rewarding progression, and plenty of brain-training fun for players of all ages.

FEATURES

- Simple and Addictive Gameplay
Tap arrows in the correct order and discover the path to victory. Every puzzle offers a unique challenge.

- Hundreds of Unique Levels
Enjoy a large collection of carefully designed puzzles that become more challenging as you progress.

- Daily Challenges
Take on fresh puzzles every day and keep your mind active with new challenges.

- Train Your Brain
Improve focus, logic, and problem-solving skills while enjoying relaxing gameplay.

- Relax and Unwind
No time limits, no pressure—just satisfying puzzles you can enjoy at your own pace.

- Smooth Experience
Clean visuals, intuitive controls, and rewarding gameplay create the perfect puzzle experience.

WHY PLAY?

Whether you're looking for a relaxing way to pass the time or a challenging brain workout, Arrow Puzzle: Maze Escape Go delivers the perfect balance of strategy and fun. Plan your moves carefully, solve increasingly tricky puzzles, and become a true puzzle master.

Download now and start your puzzle-solving journey today!

6782776811.name: Lion Dance Beats
6782776811.desc:
Lion Dance Beats turns the thunder of the lion dance drum into a game anyone can play. Tap along to real lion dance rhythms — DOM in the middle, DUK on the edges, chit and swipe accents — as glowing circles fall to the beat. Learn the traditional patterns hands-on, the way they're really played.

6763298760.name: Cat Bakery Tycoon: Idle Cafe
6763298760.desc:
Welcome to Cat Bakery Tycoon!

Run your own bakery staffed entirely by adorable cats! Bake pastries, brew coffee, serve customers, and grow your cafe into the ultimate bakery empire.

Your cute cat staff will take orders, cook in the kitchen, and serve delicious treats. Watch them level up their baking and barista skills as they work!

Features:
- Hire and manage adorable cat employees
- Bake bread, pastries, and brew hot & iced drinks
- Upgrade your kitchen with ovens, coffee machines & ice makers
- Decorate your bakery with furniture and decorations
- Survive rush hours and serve VIP customers

Start your cat bakery adventure today!

6780414588.name: Block Zen: Daily Puzzle
6780414588.desc:
Block Zen: Daily Puzzle is a calm block placement game for short daily sessions. Place pieces, clear full rows or columns, build combos, and improve your best score at your own pace.

6781882397.name: Spite & Malice — Card Game
6781882397.desc:
Think you can outwit the Devil? Prove it.

Spite & Malice is the classic stack-building card game, rebuilt from the ground up — slick new look, smarter opponents, and a devil who does NOT like to lose.

THE GOAL IS SIMPLE (winning isn't)
Be the first to empty your pay-off pile. Build the shared centre stacks up from Ace to Queen, play smart off your hand and discard piles, and use Kings as wild whenever you need them. Easy to learn in a single round — fiendish to master.

PLAY AGAINST A MIND OF ITS OWN
Four difficulty levels, from a gentle warm-up to RUTHLESS. Each opponent plays with its own attitude — some race for the win, some live to block yours. Start on Easy and earn your way up: win enough and you'll unlock Hard, then the merciless Ruthless AI.

UNLOCK THE DEVIL'S DECKS
Keep playing to reveal a gallery of wicked card themes — from the spectral Ethereal deck to the neon Cyber Devil and the gilded Gold Devil, each with its own table, cards and glow. Pick your favourite and make the table yours.

FEATURES
• Classic Spite & Malice rules, faithfully done
• Four AI difficulties — earn your way to Ruthless
• Unlockable card decks & themed tables to collect
• Need a Hint? The Devil will (grudgingly) help
• Undo a move and rethink your line
• 60-second built-in tutorial — learn by playing
• Track your time, score, best score and recent wins
• Play offline — no account needed
• Free to play

A beautifully wicked take on the card game also known as Cat and Mouse — pure strategy,

Each quiz session challenges your vocabulary, grammar, and comprehension across 10+ languages including Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Mandarin, Arabic, and more. BOBADA is made for quick laughs, strange little thoughts, and moments when your brain needs something lighter than another serious app.

You can also create your own Bobadas using preset choices, play quick mini-games, and test your instinct for what is normal — and what is pure Bobada.
Why BOBADA?
Most apps ask you to be productive, focused, serious, or perfectly organized.
BOBADA does the opposite.
It gives you a small creative break where the goal is not to be correct — the goal is to be weird, funny, and unexpected. It is a simple space for playful thinking, word humor, and absurd combinations that make you smile for no serious reason.
A banana with legal problems? A cloud with too much confidence? A sandwich applying for a passport?
That is BOBADA.

How much of a conversation can you understand without relying on sound?

Hear with Eyes is an interactive quiz game that lets hearing users experience one aspect of deaf and hard-of-hearing communication through lip reading. Instead of simply explaining the challenges of lip reading, the app invites you to experience them firsthand.

Watch short lip movement animations and guess the spoken word using visual information. A faint, muffled audio cue is available, but the primary source of information is what you see—not what you hear.

Features

• Four difficulty levels from Easy to Extreme

• Progressive gameplay that encourages observation and inference

• Replay-based scoring system that rewards careful listening and viewing

• Clean and intuitive interface designed for focused learning

• Fully playable without relying on audio

Why Hear with Eyes?

Many people assume that sign language is the primary communication method for all deaf individuals. In reality, many deaf and hard-of-hearing people also use lip reading, spoken language, writing, gestures, or a combination of communication methods.

Hear with Eyes was created to encourage empathy through direct experience rather than explanation.

This app is not intended to replicate the lived experience of deaf or hard-of-hearing individuals. Instead, it offers an opportunity to better understand some of the cognitive effort involved in lip-reading–based communication.
